settings.heading: Measure once. Choose thoughtfully.
settings.text: Use a soft measuring tape and compare your measurements with the chart provided for the individual product.

settings.heading: Chest
settings.text: Keep the tape level around the fullest part of your chest. Measure over a light layer without pulling tight.

settings.heading: Waist
settings.text: Measure around your natural waist while standing comfortably. Keep the tape flat and allow room to breathe.

settings.heading: Hips
settings.text: Stand with your feet together and measure around the fullest part of your hips.

settings.heading: Between sizes?
settings.text: Check the product-specific fit notes and contact the store if you need help. Measurements and sizing can differ between products.
